snippet.title: Neidfyre - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose. Become one of those who have set foot in Kurania, a land trapped in endless night.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4206080/Neidfyre/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
